name: @setout/api
description: The SetOut API: one Cloudflare Worker that serves the designer routes, the workspace routes and both apps.

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.typecheck: wrangler types --strict-vars false && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.json
scripts.deploy:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env staging --remote && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote && wrangler deploy --env production
